title: Design System: LabSite Studio — template basic, skins "導引" and "圖譜"

guide.name: 導引
guide.overview: A lab website read the way a visitor reads a Taiwanese hospital or campus sign program: find the building directory, pick a zone, follow its colour. Every page answers "where do I go next." Four zone colours each own whole full-width bands and colour their own page; signage-white plates sit on a cool wall grey; near-black ink carries the type. One amber mark means "you are here," and nothing else on the site is amber. The type is sign type: a heavy Chinese label with the other language set smaller and lighter beneath it, in one sans family. Depth is flat: plates meet and overlap, nothing casts a shadow. The only icon family is the arrow. Where a photo is missing, a flat wayfinding pictogram plate stands in and says it must be replaced.
notes: On-ink tints in the footer and directory sign are color-mix() of white and --ink (68-92% white), so generated themes carry them.
Header zones wrap to their own scrolling row at 1024px.
The favicon SVG still hard-codes the default research colour.

atlas.name: 圖譜
atlas.overview: Every section is a plate from a medical anatomy atlas, the book every nursing student studied for four years. White plate ground, near-black hairline ink, leader-line labels, numbered and captioned figures. The zones follow the anatomical colour convention (vein blue, lymph green, nerve ochre, fascia slate) and appear only as small key dots, coloured text and one pale flat field per page, never as solid fills. Artery red marks one thing: what the visitor is on or pointing at. A condensed label face sets labels, names, captions and numbers; a plain sans sets reading text. Depth is the plate frame and the leader line; nothing casts a shadow.
notes: site.css does not read --radius; corners are square by construction.
One pale field per page: 9% color-mix of the zone into plate (page sign on inner pages, join section on home; contact's join section returns to plate).
Figure counter reset on body; incremented on .directory__photo, .pi__photo, .member, .photo.

themeSurface.generator: src/site/themes.js makeTheme/generateThemes: zone hues via OKLCH schemes (wayfinding, analogous, mono, duo), each darkened until 4.6:1 against white and wall; join hue moved 90deg if within 40deg of amber (hue 75); radius 0, 4 or 10px; Latin-first font pairs from FONT_PAIRS. Generated sets carry no --mark (the skin keeps its own) and no --font-label; patchTheme only rewrites variables a file already declares.
themeSurface.contrastGate: contrastIssues(vars) over CONTRAST_PAIRS must return no issues (4.5:1). Pairs: on-zone on research/team/publications, on-join on join, ink and ink-soft on plate and wall, zone-team on wall, zone-publications on plate. Both shipped skins pass.
themeSurface.keepColours: src/site/skins.js themeForSkin with keepColors carries only /^--(zone-|on-|ink|wall$|plate$|rule$)/ into the new skin's theme.css; --mark, fonts and radius come from the new skin (each skin uses the mark differently). The theme generator does not set --mark.
themeSurface.skinManifest: labsite/skins.json {version:1, current, skins:[{id, name, description}]}; files at labsite/skins/<id>/site.css + theme.css; skins marked "from": "css" are copied from css/ by tools/bundle-templates.js.
fixedStructure: markup contract (docs/markup-convention.md) and templates/basic class names
data-zone values: research, team, publications, join
data-page values: index, research, members, publications, contact
centred column, 4:8 split, 7:5 directory head, rule-ruled lists, breakpoints 1024/860/640px
bilingual headings with the translation beneath

guide-on-zone.note: Fixed white by the Dark Zone Rule; themes.js always emits #ffffff.

guide-on-join.note: Fixed white by the Dark Zone Rule.

guide-mark.note: Generated themes keep amber hue 75 (oklch(0.8 0.16 75)); location and focus only.

guide-ink.note: On-ink tints in the footer and directory sign are color-mix(in srgb, #ffffff 68-92%, var(--ink)).

atlas-mark.note: Location, hover, focus and selection only. Used as text and 1-3px lines; 6.54:1 on plate as shipped. Not covered by CONTRAST_PAIRS.

atlas-on-zone.note: Declared for the shared contract and contrast gate; atlas never sets text on a solid zone fill.

guide-display.purpose: The lab name on the directory's ink sign plate; once per site.

guide-title.purpose: Zone band labels and research area titles.

guide-other-language.purpose: The translation beneath every sign heading, soft ink, with its lang attribute.

guide-label.purpose: Table heads, link plates, the language switch.

atlas-display.purpose: The lab name on the title plate; once per site. Label face.

atlas-headline.purpose: Section headings, followed by a leader line. The one heavy Public Sans voice.

atlas-title.purpose: Label-row labels, area titles; PI and member names share the face at 700.

atlas-other-language.purpose: Uppercase tracked translation beneath every heading; zone-coloured on the page sign.

atlas-label.purpose: Plate marks, PI column heads, table heads, the language switch.

atlas-figure-number.purpose: 圖 n / Fig. n from the CSS counter, run into captions or set as frame tabs.

shadows.name: guide-focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--mark)
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus only. Not elevation; the system has no elevation shadows.

shadows.name: atlas-focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus in artery red. No elevation shadows in atlas.

shadows.name: atlas-hollow-key
shadows.purpose: Draws the 1px ring of the key on a header plate without a zone. A stroke, not elevation.

motion.name: guide-ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Arrow advance (0.35-0.45s) and directory power-up (0.5-0.6s, 90ms stagger).

motion.name: guide-ease-out-cubic
motion.purpose: Zone band colour sweep, 0.5s, left to right.

motion.name: guide-colour-swap
motion.purpose: Button, header plate and link plate hover fills.

motion.name: guide-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and transforms off; everything static.

motion.name: atlas-leader-draw
motion.purpose: Label-row leader scaleX 0.6 to 1 on hover/focus; the only movement in atlas.

motion.name: atlas-pin-fade
motion.purpose: Red pin appears at the drawn leader's end.

motion.name: atlas-colour-swap
motion.purpose: Colour and row-tint changes on hover.

motion.name: atlas-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Transitions off on rows, leader, pin, arrow and buttons; end state without movement.

breakpoints.name: header-wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Header zones move to their own scrolling row (both skins); atlas label-row descriptor drops to a second row.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; zone bands and label rows restack.

breakpoints.name: small
breakpoints.purpose: Header zone row fades out at the right edge.

narrative.northStar: "One markup, many sign programs" — 導引 is "The Hospital Directory Board", 圖譜 is "The Anatomy Atlas Plate"
narrative.overview:
LabSite Studio is a template platform, so the system has two layers. The **shared structure** is fixed and every skin obeys it: the markup contract, the class names, the four zones, the theme variable names, the contrast gate. A **skin** is a whole visual world laid over that structure: its own `site.css` (layout and components) and `theme.css` (colour, type and corner tokens plus its web-font `@import`). Switching skins rewrites those two files and nothing else; not one word of a page changes. Two skins ship today: 導引 (guide, the default) and 圖譜 (atlas). Neither may borrow the other's signature devices; they share bones, not looks.

**導引 (guide).** A lab website read the way a visitor reads a Taiwanese hospital or campus sign program: find the building directory, pick a zone, follow its colour. Every page answers "where do I go next." Four zone colours each own whole full-width bands and colour their own page; signage-white plates sit on a cool wall grey; near-black ink carries the type. One amber mark means "you are here," and nothing else on the site is amber. The type is sign type: a heavy Chinese label with the other language set smaller and lighter beneath it, in one sans family. Depth is flat: plates meet and overlap, nothing casts a shadow. The only icon family is the arrow. Where a photo is missing, a flat wayfinding pictogram plate stands in and says it must be replaced.

**圖譜 (atlas).** Every section is a plate from a medical anatomy atlas, the book every nursing student studied for four years. White plate ground, near-black hairline ink, leader-line labels, numbered and captioned figures. The zones follow the anatomical colour convention (vein blue, lymph green, nerve ochre, fascia slate) and appear only as small key dots, coloured text and one pale flat field per page, never as solid fills. Artery red marks one thing: what the visitor is on or pointing at. A condensed label face sets labels, names, captions and numbers; a plain sans sets reading text. Depth is the plate frame and the leader line; nothing casts a shadow.
keyCharacteristics: One markup contract, one set of theme variable names, one contrast gate; each skin a separate world.
Four zones (research, team, publications, join) carry identity in every skin; how they appear is the skin's choice.
One reserved mark colour per skin for location and focus: amber in 導引, artery red in 圖譜.
Bilingual headings with the other language beneath, never a label above.
Flat in both skins: depth from overlapping plates (導引) or plate frames and leader lines (圖譜).

rules.name: The Theme Surface Rule
rules.body: Only the `:root` custom properties in a skin's `theme.css` and its font `@import` are swappable. Every skin defines the full shared variable set; every pair in `CONTRAST_PAIRS` must pass 4.5:1 before a theme ships. A skin's `site.css` may derive tints from theme variables with `color-mix()` but may not introduce a colour a theme cannot reach.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Each skin reserves `--mark` for location and focus and uses it for nothing else.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Amber marks only location and focus: the current page, the focused element, selection, the skip link. A generated theme moves any zone hue within 40 degrees of amber away from it.

rules.name: The Dark Zone Rule
rules.body: All four zones are dark enough to carry white text at 4.5:1, and dark enough to read as text on plate and wall at 4.5:1. `--on-zone` and `--on-join` stay white; a theme that needs dark text on a zone is outside the system.

rules.name: The Artery Rule
rules.body: Red marks only what the visitor is on or pointing at: the current page, hover, focus, the drawn leader and its pin, selection. Nothing at rest is red.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Each page has exactly one pale zone field, a 9% `color-mix()` of the zone into plate: the page sign on inner pages, the join section on the home page. On the contact page the join section returns to plate white so the page sign stays the only field. Label rows on hover take a 7% tint, which is state, not a field.

rules.name: The Key, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Zone colours appear as small key dots, as text, and in the one pale field; never as a solid band or button fill.

rules.name: The Bilingual Sign Rule
rules.body: Every section heading is a pair: the page language as a heavy label, the other language smaller, 600 weight, soft ink, directly beneath, marked with its `lang`. The second line is a translation, never a category tag or a teaser.

rules.name: The Counted Figure Rule
rules.body: Figures are numbered by a CSS counter reset on `body` and incremented on the directory photo, the PI photo, each member and each gallery photo. Captioned figures run the number in ("圖 1　" / "Fig. 1  "); uncaptioned ones (PI, members) carry it as a white tab in the frame's top-left corner, with a 1px ink right and bottom edge. Numbers are never typed into content.

rules.name: The Plate Mark Rule
rules.body: Each inner page is a numbered plate: 圖版 I research, 圖版 II members, 圖版 III publications, 圖版 IV contact (PLATE I–IV on English pages), set in the label face in a 1px ink box at the page sign's top right, beside the title, not above it.

rules.name: The Keep-All Rule
rules.body: Short sign labels (band descriptors, PI list items, tags, member roles, alumni destinations) use `word-break: keep-all` with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, so Chinese breaks only at spaces and 、，, never inside a word. Headings balance; paragraphs and list items wrap pretty.

rules.name: The Shared Column Rule (圖譜)
rules.body: Rows of one plate align to one grid: label rows use `subgrid`, so leaders never start at different x.

rules.name: The Overlapping Plate Rule (導引)
rules.body: If something needs to read as in front, it overlaps the plane behind it; it never floats on a shadow.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule (圖譜)
rules.body: Structure is drawn, never shaded: 1px ink for frames and the top of every list, 1px hairline grey between rows. No line is heavier than 1px except the 3px current-page bar.

dos: Do give every new page or section a zone through `data-zone` (research, team, publications, join) and let the skin's `--zone` colour it.
Do set every section heading as a bilingual pair: the page language as the heading, the other-language line beneath with `lang`.
Do define every shared theme variable in a new skin's `theme.css`, keep the class names, and run the colours through `contrastIssues()` before shipping.
Do change a skin's look through its `theme.css` tokens and font `@import`; change `site.css` only as a whole skin that keeps the markup contract.
Do (導引) make depth by overlapping plates over bands.
Do (導引) use the arrow (24-unit viewBox, 2.6 stroke, square caps) as the only icon.
Do (導引) keep amber for the current page, focus, selection and the skip link only; all four zones dark, white text on all of them.
Do (導引) keep motion to the directory power-up and the band sweep, with exponential ease-outs.
Do (圖譜) draw structure with 1px lines: ink for frames and list tops, hairline grey between rows.
Do (圖譜) number figures with the CSS counter and mark inner pages with 圖版 I–IV / PLATE I–IV.
Do (圖譜) keep one pale zone field per page and align label rows on one subgrid.
Do (圖譜) keep red for current, hover, focus and selection; let only the label-row leader move, and only on hover or focus.
donts: Don't rename, add or remove markup or class names in a skin, or bake any school or department identity into a template.
Don't add a small label above a heading; the other-language line goes beneath, and it is a translation.
Don't introduce colours in `site.css` that a theme cannot reach.
Don't use shadows for elevation in either skin.
Don't add a big photo hero or a grid of identical icon cards; the directory is the home page.
Don't (導引) add icon families, glyph icons or decorative illustrations; arrows and replaceable pictograms only.
Don't (導引) use amber, or any hue within 40 degrees of it, as a zone colour, or put dark text on a zone fill.
Don't (圖譜) fill a band, button or block with a solid zone colour, or round a corner.
Don't (圖譜) use red for anything at rest, or move anything but the label-row leader (colour and the pin's fade are the only other transitions).
Don't (圖譜) borrow the guide's solid zone bands, amber, or overlapping plates.
